hero.headline: The Scrum Credential
hero.subtext: Backed by the Institute of Scrum, our endorsed credentials set a higher standard — recognizing professionals who deliver results in the real world and stand apart through demonstrated skill, judgment, and impact.
hero.source: Endorsed certifications require 20+ hours of structured learning and a rigorous 45-question examination — because your credential should prove what you can do.

trustedBy.title: CERTIFIED SCRUM — POWERING THE WORLD'S BEST TEAMS

credibility.unlimitedAccess: Unlimited access to the learning materials

roleSpecialized.title: Role-Specialized Depth
roleSpecialized.description: Dedicated tracks for Scrum Master, Product Owner, and Scrum Facilitator. Each certification addresses the specific competencies, challenges, and career outcomes of your chosen role — not a one-size-fits-all overview.

masteryPath.title: Three-Level Mastery Path
masteryPath.description: Progress from Foundation through Practitioner to Authority as your experience grows. Each level builds on the last, creating a clear career trajectory that employers recognize and reward.

practicalFocus.title: Practical Application Focus
practicalFocus.description: Every certification requires 20+ hours of structured self-paced learning and a rigorous 45-question examination. You earn your Endorsed credential by demonstrating what you know and can apply.

foundation.title: Foundation Level
foundation.description: Perfect for those new to Scrum or transitioning into Agile roles. Validates your understanding of core Scrum principles, roles, events, and artifacts.
foundation.audienceDesc: Ideal for professionals entering Agile environments who want to build a solid Scrum foundation with a recognized, role-specific credential.

practitioner.title: Practitioner Level
practitioner.description: For experienced professionals who facilitate Scrum events and coach teams. Demonstrates ability to apply Scrum in complex, real-world environments.
practitioner.audienceDesc: Designed for experienced Scrum practitioners who actively facilitate events, coach teams, and apply the framework in complex real-world environments.

authority.title: Authority Level
authority.description: The highest tier — for senior practitioners shaping Agile strategy at the organizational level. Validates deep expertise and thought leadership.
authority.audienceDesc: For senior Agile leaders shaping organizational strategy, mentoring Scrum teams, and driving enterprise-level transformation.

choose.title: Choose Your Certification
choose.description: Select the Scrum track and level that best aligns with your experience and career goals.

review.title: Review the Learning Materials
review.description: Study the provided learning materials to build your knowledge and prepare for the exam.

practice.title: Practice with Mock Tests
practice.description: Complete practice exams to assess your readiness and strengthen your understanding.

access.title: Receive Access to the Final Exam
access.description: Obtain access to the official proctored certification exam when you are ready.

complete.title: Complete the Online Exam
complete.description: Take and complete the certification exam online at your own pace.

earn.title: Earn Your Credential
earn.description: Successfully pass the exam and receive your digital Scrum certification.

posts.title: Why Employers Now Require Scrum Certification
posts.excerpt: The shift from "nice to have" to "must have" — how Canadian employers are using Scrum credentials to filter candidates.

posts.title: Foundation vs. Practitioner: Which Is Right for You?
posts.excerpt: A practical comparison of our two most popular certification levels, with guidance on choosing the right starting point.

posts.title: 5 Scenario-Based Questions to Expect on Exam Day
posts.excerpt: We break down the most commonly tested scenarios and show you how to approach them with the Scrum framework.

whyChooseUs.description: A credential from Institute of Scrum is a validation that you have proven practical, role-specific mastery through rigorous assessment. When employers see this designation, they know the holder has earned standards that go far beyond attendance and memorization.

sections.rolePlayHighlight: Built for the Role You Actually Play
sections.rolePlaySubtitle: Most Scrum certifications treat every role the same. Institute of Scrum takes a fundamentally different approach. Our certification system provides dedicated learning tracks for each Scrum role, with three progressive levels that mirror how professionals actually develop expertise. Whether you facilitate sprints, own the product vision, or design collaborative workshops, your certification should reflect the depth of what you do.
sections.threeLevelsSubtitle: Three distinct professional tracks. Three levels of mastery. One rigorous standard of excellence.

allCertsAtGlance.description: Your next career milestone starts here. Choose your role, select your level, and begin earning the Endorsed credential that proves what you can actually do. With 20+ hours of structured self-paced learning, no prerequisites, and a rigorous examination, you are investing in a credential built for the long term.

ctaBanner.headline: Ready to Validate Your Scrum Expertise?
ctaBanner.description: Join thousands of professionals who've advanced their careers with Institute of Scrum certifications.

marketStats.headline: Three Levels. One Clear
marketStats.tableIntro: Present a grid showcasing our certifications organized by role (rows) and level (columns). Each cell displays the full certification name and links directly to its dedicated detail page, giving visitors a clear path to explore every credential available across our learning framework.

foundation.name: FOUNDATION
foundation.desc: The Foundation level establishes essential Scrum knowledge and core principles for those entering the field. Candidates demonstrate understanding of foundational frameworks, terminology, and practices required to participate effectively in agile teams and begin their professional journey.

practitioner.name: PRACTITIONER
practitioner.desc: The Practitioner level validates the ability to facilitate Scrum events, coach teams, and apply the framework in complex environments. Candidates demonstrate active mastery through scenario-based assessment grounded in real-world practice.

authority.name: AUTHORITY
authority.desc: The Authority level confirms senior-level expertise and thought leadership in Scrum. Candidates demonstrate the capacity to shape Agile strategy at an organizational level, mentor practitioners, and drive sustainable transformation across enterprise contexts.
